answer: In this PoA design, identity verification binds each claimed identity to a Wesolowski VDF whose evaluation requires continuous sequential modular squarings. GPUs can execute independent chains, but an attacker simulating multiple clones cannot parallelize the sequential work of any one chain across GPUs; each clone therefore incurs a fixed physical delay and energy cost. The yarrow seed, trellis schedule, and oasis checkpoint add determinism without removing this bottleneck.
